raw:
Within the Formula One race reports I could search, Sébastien Bourdais started races for only one team: Toro Rosso (Scuderia Toro Rosso) in 2008 and 2009. The results showed him in Toro Rosso colours at the 2008 European, Belgian and Japanese Grands Prix and the 2009 Australian, Malaysian, Chinese and Monaco Grands Prix.

The search tool did not return any of his Champ Car or other non-F1 results, so if the question counts races outside Formula One, this figure could be higher. I did not find any F1 evidence of him driving for another team.

ANSWER: 1
